blocks.text: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina — Pope Leo XIV praised the “indispensable” role played by trade unions in a speech Monday in Argentina, where President Javier Milei has curtailed the right to strike. “Trade unions are indispensable institutions when they defend those who have no voice and resist the commodification of labor,” he told a group of business leaders, workers and union members. “When economic profit is established as the sole criterion of success, a business becomes dehumanized,” he warned.
